instruction: Get Mux to repair the jammed door between the back room and the bar.

target.reason: The instruction wants the jammed door repaired, but the page offers no repair action (only depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, refuse) and none of the available end states — an item changing hands, a person being in a room, or a person having spoken — captures a door being fixed. Mux already holds the charge-cell and can be moved or made to talk, but nothing on the page can bring about or verify the repair.
